mentions.name: Just The Headlines
mentions.description: A widget-first RSS headline viewer app that displays RSS headlines via home screen widgets; its website showcases screenshots, and the app is in the required closed testing phase for Google Play Store approval.
mentions.source_excerpt: The companion app, a widget-first RSS headline viewer called Just The Headlines is just about done too. Site is online if you want to see screenshots: https://justtheheadlines.app
mentions.author: jjordan
